name: WebGPU / WGSL Memory Model
authors: W3C GPU for the Web WG
description: A relaxed, scoped memory model for portable GPU compute in the browser, derived closely from Vulkan's. WGSL provides relaxed atomics, work-group barriers and storage/work-group address spaces; implementations lower it to Vulkan, Metal or Direct3D 12.

catSupport.note: Derived from Vulkan's per-execution scoped model and specified in prose in the WGSL spec; no formal cat (or Alloy) artefact of its own.
